fr.expertise_intro: Son parcours clinique couvre la chirurgie de la main, la reconstruction complexe, les lésions des nerfs périphériques et la chirurgie du membre supérieur spastique.
areas: Chirurgie des atteintes et des blessures de la main, avec une attention portée à la récupération de la fonction.
Reconstruction après des lésions complexes, notamment dans le contexte de traumatismes.
Chirurgie des lésions nerveuses périphériques dans le cadre de la reconstruction et de la récupération fonctionnelle.
Chirurgie reconstructrice du bras et de la main dans le contexte de la spasticité.
fr.about_intro: La Dre Charlotte Jaloux est chirurgienne plasticienne et de la main à l’Hôpital général de Montréal. Elle a rejoint l’équipe de chirurgie plastique en juin 2025.
training: Diplôme de médecine à Aix-Marseille Université en 2012, puis formation en chirurgie plastique et reconstructrice à Marseille.
Formation complémentaire en chirurgie de la main à l’Institut de la Main, avec un intérêt particulier pour le membre supérieur spastique.
Ancienne cheffe du service de chirurgie de la main et de reconstruction des membres à Marseille.
fr.research: Titulaire d’un doctorat en neurosciences, la Dre Jaloux s’intéresse à la récupération fonctionnelle du membre supérieur et à la régénération des nerfs périphériques.

en.home_intro: Dr. Charlotte Jaloux is a member of the plastic surgery team at the Montreal General Hospital.
en.expertise_intro: Her clinical background includes hand surgery, complex reconstruction, peripheral nerve injuries and surgery for upper-limb spasticity.
areas: Surgery for conditions and injuries affecting the hand, with a focus on functional recovery.
Reconstruction following complex injuries, including traumatic injuries.
Surgery for peripheral nerve injuries as part of reconstruction and functional recovery.
Reconstructive surgery of the arm and hand in the context of spasticity.
en.about_intro: Dr. Charlotte Jaloux is a plastic and hand surgeon at the Montreal General Hospital. She joined the plastic surgery team in June 2025.
training: Medical degree from Aix-Marseille University in 2012, followed by residency training in plastic and reconstructive surgery in Marseille.
Hand surgery fellowship at the Institut de la Main, with a particular focus on surgery for upper-limb spasticity.
Former head of hand surgery and limb reconstruction at Hôpital de la Timone in Marseille.
en.research: Dr. Jaloux holds a PhD in neuroscience. Her research interests include upper-limb functional recovery and peripheral nerve regeneration.
en.scope: Contact the Plastic Surgery Department to find out whether a consultation is available for your situation.
en.contact_intro: For questions about a consultation, contact the Plastic Surgery Department at the Montreal General Hospital.
en.email_note: The department email is for general inquiries. Please avoid sending medical records or personal health information to this address.
faq: How do I book an appointment?
Call the Plastic Surgery Department for guidance on the appointment process.
Do I need a referral?
The Plastic Surgery Department can tell you whether a referral is needed for your situation.
Where should a referral be sent?
The department can confirm how to send a referral and which documents to include. Its details are listed on the Contact page.
Which documents should I bring?
When confirming your appointment, ask the department which documents or results to bring.
What conditions fall within her practice?
See the Expertise page for documented areas of expertise. The department can advise you based on your situation.
